title: Which months should we use for a mango tree's mean?
description: A mango tree gives fruit only in the summer months. The video finds the mean and the median for all twelve months and for the summer months, and shows which describes the tree better. Keeko calls the tree a poor one.
teaching_notes: One idea: when zeros are expected, because nothing grows in those months, we find the mean and the median over the months that matter. Watch for students who say the tree is poor because the all year mean is small.

source: Sita's mango tree gave 0, 0, 8, 24, 41, 16, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 mangoes from January to December
video_script.why: The child has seen that a zero counts, and now sees a case where zeros are expected and should be set aside.
video_script.substitution: The book's own mango tree, twelve months and five summer months.
video_script.anchor: Twelve month cards from January to December: 0, 0, 8, 24, 41, 16, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 mangoes.
video_script.wrong_move: Judges the tree by the all year mean, which counts the months when mangoes do not grow at all.
video_script.payoff_line: In the summer months the tree gives about eighteen point eight mangoes a month.

final_answer.value: all year: mean 7.83, median 0; summer months: mean 18.8, median 16 mangoes per month
final_answer.spoken: summer mean eighteen point eight, summer median sixteen mangoes per month

names.Jia: the child who owns the mango tree

maths_rules: all twelve months: seven zeros, so the 6th and 7th sorted values are 0 and the median is 0
all twelve months: mean 94 / 12 = 7.83 (to two decimal places)
summer months March to July: 8, 24, 41, 16, 5; sorted 5, 8, 16, 24, 41; median 16
video_script.design: One idea: set aside the months where zero is expected. Twelve month cards sit in the anchor; the five summer cards lift out to the board while the seven zero cards fade.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>This is a question from your book about Jia and a mango tree in the backyard.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The tree gave mangoes every month of last year, from January to December.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>In some months it gave none, and in others it gave a lot.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>We want the mean and the median mangoes per month.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>Should we use all twelve months, or only some of them?

beats.on_screen: the cards hold still and the row gets an accent underline

marks.m1: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the five summer cards March to July glow; the other seven cards fade and are labelled mangoes do not grow

marks.m3: the label mangoes do not grow appears on them

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Mangoes are expected to grow only in the summer months.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>In the other months the tree gives none, because mangoes do not grow then.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Those zeros are expected, so they are not a failed harvest.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Given, the mangoes from January to December are on the board.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seven of the twelve months show zero.

beats.on_screen: To find: mean and median for all 12 months, and for the 5 summer months

marks.m1: the words all twelve months and summer months are written

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to find the mean and the median for all twelve months, and for the summer months.

marks.m1: the five months with mangoes are added

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, add up the mangoes of the whole year.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Only five months give any, and they add up to ninety four mangoes.

marks.m1: the twelve cards sort and seven zeros come first

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, take all twelve months.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seven are zeros, so the sixth and seventh scores are both zero, and the median is zero.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>For the mean, share ninety four mangoes among twelve months.

beats.on_screen: summer months March to July: sorted 5, 8, 16, 24, 41; the middle card 16 glows; median = 16

marks.m1: the five summer cards lift out

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, take only the summer months, from March to July.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Sort the five months from the smallest to the largest.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Sixteen is in the middle, with two months on each side, so the median is sixteen mangoes.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, share the same ninety four mangoes among only the five summer months.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That is ninety four shared by five.

beats.on_screen: Answer: summer months: mean 18.8, median 16 mangoes; all year: mean ≈ 7.83, median 0

marks.m2: the all year answer is shown beside it

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>In the summer months the tree gives about eighteen point eight mangoes a month.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>For all twelve months, the mean is seven point eight three and the median is zero.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: poor tree crossed out; the seven zero cards labelled expected

marks.m3: the summer figures replace the words poor tree

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko thinks this is a poor tree, because the mean over all twelve months is small.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But mangoes grow only in the summer months, so the other zeros are not failures.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The summer figures describe the tree better.
